# MM-P3-L2-RR02 - Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-RR02

Scope
This document provides the required preventive maintenance tasks for EQ-P3-L2-RR02 focused on mandrel clamp torque verification and main roll bearing lubrication. It applies to maintenance technicians and shift engineers responsible for routine upkeep and safety checks. Refer to ECN-2026-044 for engineering changes and to SOP-P3-L2-01 and SOP-P3-L2-04 for lockout/tagout and confined workspace procedures.

Tools
- Calibrated torque wrench capable of reading the specified torque value
- Approved grease gun compatible with machine fittings
- Manufacturer-specified grease cartridge
- Inspection mirror and clean lint-free cloth
- Personal protective equipment per SOP-P3-L2-01

Procedure
- Prepare the machine for maintenance following SOP-P3-L2-01 and SOP-P3-L2-04. Ensure all energy sources are isolated and tagged per the cited procedures before accessing the mandrel clamp and bearing locations.
- Clean the mandrel clamp bolt area to remove debris and old lubricant. Inspect the bolt and surrounding hardware for visible damage or wear.
- Using the calibrated torque wrench, set and apply the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 475 N·m. Confirm the wrench calibration certificate is valid per plant calibration program.
- Access the main roll bearing lubrication fittings. Apply grease using the approved grease gun until the fitting indicates full or until excess grease is displaced and wiped away. Record the lubrication activity in the maintenance log.
- Schedule lubrication actions to meet the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 105 hours. Coordinate with production to minimize downtime and ensure adherence to this interval.

Acceptance criteria
- Mandrel clamp bolts maintain the specified torque: mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 475 N·m.
- Main roll bearings show no signs of grease starvation or contamination between scheduled lubrication events aligned with main roll bearing lubrication interval for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 105 hours.
- Maintenance actions documented and cross-referenced to ECN-2026-044, SOP-P3-L2-01, and SOP-P3-L2-04.
